sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:1
items.html: the discernment of the Yesod, the womb, and the Kli [vessel] in her, within which the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] would afterwards be: This has already been explained: in the first intercourse he returns her posterior, which is her AHP, and returns it from the place of BYA to complete the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of Atzilut; and they are the discernments of her new NHY, which she attains now, as above in the adjacent item. You also know that with these posteriors are also attached the discernments of the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous, for so were they attached one to another while they were in BYA. However, at this first intercourse they are still without depiction, for the upper discernment of the souls of the righteous must be completed first, which is the Nukva. Only afterwards — that is, after the Nukva has already attained all her completeness from the first intercourse — are the anterior vessels depicted in the discernments of MAN within the complete posteriors of the Nukva, which are the Yesod, the womb, and the vessel that raises the MAN in her. And this is what he says, that afterwards the MAN would be within it.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:2
items.html: One name BON, which is the Gevurot mentioned, and it becomes a Kli in her: That is, the discernments of the square of the HaVaYaH of BON, which are AB [72] and KADEM [144], which are RIU [216] in Gematria, as above in the words of the ARI, item 10.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:13:3
items.html: The Ruach that her husband placed in her at the first Zivug: For in the completed posteriors there is a discernment of a vessel and a discernment of light. Therefore there are discerned in them a vessel for raising the MAN and the light within the vessel, which is the Ruach that her husband placed in her at the first intercourse. And all the new MAN that are born and go out from there take with them a portion of that light, that is, of that Ruach.
